instances.question: I want to analyze how the Signal-to-Noise Quality Indicator (SNQI) varies across different weather conditions. For each weather condition, give weather condition name, the average SNQI, the median SNQI, and count how many analyzable signals there are. Sort the result by average SNQI in descending order.

verdict.error: Test case errors: Test case failed due to assertion error: ex_base returned 0 but expected 1.

candidates:
WITH joined AS
  (SELECT o.weathprofile,
          s.snrratio AS snqi
   FROM signals s
   JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
   JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
   JOIN signaldecoding d ON s.signalregistry = d.signalref
   WHERE d.decodestat = 'Completed'),
     ranked AS
  (SELECT weathprofile,
          snqi,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY weathprofile) AS cnt,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY weathprofile
                             ORDER BY snqi) AS rn
   FROM joined)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(snqi) AS avg_snqi,
       AVG(CASE
               WHEN rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) THEN snqi
           END) AS median_snqi,
       COUNT(*) AS analyzable_signal_count
FROM ranked
GROUP BY weathprofile
ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;

instances.question: Give me a ranked list of all our observatory sites by their current observation quality. For each observatory, I need fileds: the station name, telescope ID, calculated Observation Quality Factor, any equipment problems listed together sepearated by comma, how many issues there are, and the Observational Confidence Level. Please rank them by Observation Quality Factor with the best first.

WITH scores AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,
         t.observstation,
         (CASE t.equipstatus WHEN 'Operational' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Degraded' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.calibrstatus WHEN 'Current' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Due' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.focusquality WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.coolsysstatus WHEN 'Normal' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.powerstatus WHEN 'Main' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Backup' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.datastorstatus WHEN 'Available' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.netstatus WHEN 'Connected' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.procqueuestatus WHEN 'Empty' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
         ) / 8.0 * 100.0 AS observation_quality_factor
  FROM telescopes t
),
problems AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry AS telescope_id, 'equipstatus: ' || t.equipstatus AS problem FROM telescopes t WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Operational'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'calibrstatus: ' || t.calibrstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.calibrstatus <> 'Current'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'focusquality: ' || t.focusquality FROM telescopes t WHERE t.focusquality <> 'Excellent'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'coolsysstatus: ' || t.coolsysstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.coolsysstatus <> 'Normal'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'powerstatus: ' || t.powerstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.powerstatus <> 'Main'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'datastorstatus: ' || t.datastorstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.datastorstatus <> 'Available'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'netstatus: ' || t.netstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.netstatus <> 'Connected'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'procqueuestatus: ' || t.procqueuestatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.procqueuestatus <> 'Empty'
),
prob_agg AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_id, GROUP_CONCAT(problem, ', ') AS equipment_problems, COUNT(*) AS issue_count
  FROM problems GROUP BY observstation, telescope_id
)
SELECT o.observstation AS station_name,
       s.telescope_id,
       ROUND(s.observation_quality_factor, 2) AS observation_quality_factor,
       COALESCE(p.equipment_problems, '') AS equipment_problems,
       COALESCE(p.issue_count, 0) AS issue_count,
       CASE WHEN s.observation_quality_factor >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN s.observation_quality_factor >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS observational_confidence_level
FROM observatories o
JOIN scores s ON s.observstation = o.observstation
LEFT JOIN prob_agg p ON p.observstation = o.observstation AND p.telescope_id = s.telescope_id
ORDER BY observation_quality_factor DESC;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH scores AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,
         t.observstation,
         (CASE t.equipstatus WHEN 'Operational' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Degraded' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.calibrstatus WHEN 'Current' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Due' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.focusquality WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.coolsysstatus WHEN 'Normal' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.powerstatus WHEN 'Main' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Backup' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.datastorstatus WHEN 'Available' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.netstatus WHEN 'Connected' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
          + CASE t.procqueuestatus WHEN 'Empty' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END
         ) / 8.0 * 100.0 AS observation_quality_factor
  FROM telescopes t
),
problems AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry AS telescope_id, 'equipstatus: ' || t.equipstatus AS problem FROM telescopes t WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Operational'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'calibrstatus: ' || t.calibrstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.calibrstatus <> 'Current'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'focusquality: ' || t.focusquality FROM telescopes t WHERE t.focusquality <> 'Excellent'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'coolsysstatus: ' || t.coolsysstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.coolsysstatus <> 'Normal'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'powerstatus: ' || t.powerstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.powerstatus <> 'Main'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'datastorstatus: ' || t.datastorstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.datastorstatus <> 'Available'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'netstatus: ' || t.netstatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.netstatus <> 'Connected'
  UNION ALL SELECT t.observstation, t.telescregistry, 'procqueuestatus: ' || t.procqueuestatus FROM telescopes t WHERE t.procqueuestatus <> 'Empty'
),
prob_agg AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_id, GROUP_CONCAT(problem, ', ') AS equipment_problems, COUNT(*) AS issue_count
  FROM problems GROUP BY observstation, telescope_id
)
SELECT o.observstation AS station_name,
       s.telescope_id,
       ROUND(s.observation_quality_factor, 2) AS observation_quality_factor,
       COALESCE(p.equipment_problems, '') AS equipment_problems,
       COALESCE(p.issue_count, 0) AS issue_count,
       CASE WHEN s.observation_quality_factor >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN s.observation_quality_factor >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS observational_confidence_level
FROM observatories o
JOIN scores s ON s.observstation = o.observstation
LEFT JOIN prob_agg p ON p.observstation = o.observstation AND p.telescope_id = s.telescope_id
ORDER BY observation_quality_factor DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.telescregistry IS NULL;
SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) c FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING c > 1 LIMIT 5;"}

SELECT
    t.observstation,
    t.telescregistry,
    s.signalregistry,
    ROUND(
        o.atmostransparency
        * CASE TRIM(o.seeingprofile) WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0.5 END
        * CASE TRIM(o.weathprofile) WHEN 'Clear' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Partially Cloudy' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0.6 END
        * CASE WHEN o.windspeedms < 15 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.8 END
        * CASE TRIM(o.geomagstatus) WHEN 'Quiet' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.9 END,
        4
    ) AS aoi,
    ROUND(
        CASE TRIM(o.lunarstage) WHEN 'Full' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'First Quarter' THEN 0.6 WHEN 'Last Quarter' THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.2 END
        * ((180.0 - o.lunardistdeg) / 180.0)
        * CASE TRIM(o.weathprofile) WHEN 'Clear' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Partially Cloudy' THEN 0.7 ELSE 0.4 END,
        4
    ) AS lif,
    ROUND(
        (o.atmostransparency
         * CASE TRIM(o.seeingprofile) WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0.5 END
         * CASE TRIM(o.weathprofile) WHEN 'Clear' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Partially Cloudy' THEN 0.8 ELSE 0.6 END
         * CASE WHEN o.windspeedms < 15 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.8 END
         * CASE TRIM(o.geomagstatus) WHEN 'Quiet' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.9 END)
        * (1 - (CASE TRIM(o.lunarstage) WHEN 'Full' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'First Quarter' THEN 0.6 WHEN 'Last Quarter' THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.2 END
               * ((180.0 - o.lunardistdeg) / 180.0)
               * CASE TRIM(o.weathprofile) WHEN 'Clear' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Partially Cloudy' THEN 0.7 ELSE 0.4 END)),

    ) AS oqf
FROM signals s
JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref

Since no LIF formula is documented, I'll build it from the two lunar columns: a moon-phase factor (Full=1, quarters=0.5, New=0) times a proximity factor (1 − lunardistdeg/180), giving a 0–1 score where >0.5 means substantial lunar interference. SELECT COUNT(*) AS affected
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
WHERE (CASE o.lunarstage
         WHEN 'Full' THEN 1.0
         WHEN 'First Quarter' THEN 0.5
         WHEN 'Last Quarter' THEN 0.5
         ELSE 0.0 END) * (1 - o.lunardistdeg/180.0) > 0.5;

);

For each piece of equipment, please provide its ID, PRU value (rounded to two decimal places), average processing time in hours, efficiency ranking, workflow efficiency status, and include the CPU usage (named 'cpu_usage'), GPU usage (named 'gpu_usage'), and processing hours (named 'processing_hours') in json format as resource details. WITH per_equip AS
  (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equip_id,
          ROUND(AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2.0), 2) AS pru,
          ROUND(AVG(sp.flowhrs), 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
          ROUND(AVG(sp.proccpu), 2) AS cpu_usage,
          ROUND(AVG(sp.procgpu), 2) AS gpu_usage,
          ROUND(SUM(sp.flowhrs), 2) AS processing_hours
   FROM equipment e
   LEFT JOIN scanprocessing sp ON TRIM(e.equipregistry) = TRIM(sp.equipref)
   GROUP BY e.equipregistry)
SELECT equip_id,
       pru,
       avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (
                    ORDER BY pru ASC) AS efficiency_ranking,
       CASE
           WHEN pru < 70 THEN 'High Efficiency'
           WHEN pru <= 80 THEN 'Moderate Efficiency'
           ELSE 'Low Efficiency'
       END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
       json_object('cpu_usage', cpu_usage, 'gpu_usage', gpu_usage, 'processing_hours', processing_hours) AS resource_details
FROM per_equip
ORDER BY pru ASC;

       CASE

SELECT flowsoft AS software,
       flowstage AS stage,
       ROUND(AVG(flowhrs), 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
       ROUND(AVG(proccpu), 2) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(procgpu), 2) AS avg_gpu_usage_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(memusagegb), 2) AS avg_data_size_gb,
       ROUND(AVG(flowhrs / memusagegb), 4) AS avg_per,
       CASE
           WHEN AVG(flowhrs / memusagegb) > 1.0 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected'
           ELSE 'Efficient'
       END AS efficiency_status,
       COUNT(*) AS workflow_count
FROM scanprocessing
GROUP BY flowsoft,
         flowstage
ORDER BY CASE
             WHEN AVG(flowhrs / memusagegb) > 1.0 THEN 0
             ELSE 1
         END,
         AVG(flowhrs / memusagegb) ASC;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH pcdr AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref AS z, pc.pointdense * 1.0 / pc.clouddense AS v
  FROM scanpointcloud pc
  JOIN scans s ON s.arcref = pc.arcref
),
fee AS (
  SELECT f.zoneref AS z, f.traitcount * 1.0 / f.articount AS v
  FROM scanfeatures f
)
SELECT z.zoneregistry AS site_code,
       AVG(p.v) AS avg_pcdr,
       AVG(f.v) AS avg_fee
FROM sites z
LEFT JOIN pcdr p ON p.z = z.zoneregistry
LEFT JOIN fee f ON f.z = z.zoneregistry
GROUP BY z.zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC
LIMIT 10;"}

WITH base AS
  (SELECT c.tenureyrs,
          c.tenureyrs * 4 AS cohort_quarter,
          CASE
              WHEN json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.onlineuse') = 'High'
                   OR json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.mobileuse') = 'High' THEN 'true'
              ELSE 'false'
          END AS is_digital_first,
          (h.chanusescore + h.produsescore) / 2.0 AS ces
   FROM core_record c
   JOIN employment_and_income e ON e.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
   JOIN expenses_and_assets x ON x.expemplref = e.emplcoreref
   JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON b.bankexpref = x.expemplref
   JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = b.bankexpref
   JOIN credit_accounts_and_history h ON h.histcompref = cc.compbankref)
SELECT cohort_quarter,
       is_digital_first AS bool,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
       ROUND(AVG(ces), 4) AS avg_ces,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE
                             WHEN ces >= 0.7 THEN 1
                             ELSE 0

       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE
                             WHEN is_digital_first = 'true'
                                  AND ces >= 0.7 THEN 1
                             ELSE 0
                         END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE
                                               WHEN is_digital_first = 'true' THEN 1
                                               ELSE 0
                                           END), 0), 2) AS pct_digital_first_high_engagement
FROM base
GROUP BY cohort_quarter,
         is_digital_first
ORDER BY cohort_quarter,

{"sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.tenureyrs,
         c.tenureyrs * 4 AS cohort_quarter,
         CASE WHEN json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.onlineuse') = 'High'
               OR json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.mobileuse') = 'High'
              THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS is_digital_first,
         (h.chanusescore + h.produsescore) / 2.0 AS ces
  FROM core_record c
  JOIN employment_and_income e ON e.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
  JOIN expenses_and_assets x ON x.expemplref = e.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON b.bankexpref = x.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = b.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history h ON h.histcompref = cc.compbankref
)
SELECT cohort_quarter,
       is_digital_first AS bool,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
       ROUND(AVG(ces), 4) AS avg_ces,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN ces >= 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS pct_cohort_high_engagement,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_first = 'true' AND ces >= 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_first = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS pct_digital_first_high_engagement
FROM base
GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_first
ORDER BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_first;"}

WITH base AS
  (SELECT c.tenureyrs,
          c.tenureyrs * 4 AS cohort_quarter,
          CASE
              WHEN json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.onlineuse') = 'High'
                   OR json_extract(b.chaninvdatablock, '$.mobileuse') = 'High' THEN 'true'
              ELSE 'false'
          END AS is_digital_first,
          (h.chanusescore + h.produsescore) / 2.0 AS ces
   FROM core_record c
   JOIN employment_and_income e ON e.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
   JOIN expenses_and_assets x ON x.expemplref = e.emplcoreref
   JOIN bank_and_transactions b ON b.bankexpref = x.expemplref
   JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = b.bankexpref
   JOIN credit_accounts_and_history h ON h.histcompref = cc.compbankref)
SELECT cohort_quarter,
       is_digital_first AS bool,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
       ROUND(AVG(ces), 4) AS avg_ces,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE
                             WHEN ces >= 0.7 THEN 1
                             ELSE 0
                         END), 2) AS pct_cohort_high_engagement,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE
                             WHEN is_digital_first = 'true'
                                  AND ces >= 0.7 THEN 1
                             ELSE 0
                         END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE
                                               WHEN is_digital_first = 'true' THEN 1
                                               ELSE 0
                                           END), 0), 2) AS pct_digital_first_high_engagement
FROM base
GROUP BY cohort_quarter,
         is_digital_first
ORDER BY cohort_quarter,
         is_digital_first;

          x.mthexp / e.mthincome AS tdsr
   FROM core_record c
   JOIN employment_and_income e ON e.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
   JOIN expenses_and_assets x ON x.expemplref = e.emplcoreref
   WHERE c.clientseg IN
       (SELECT clientseg
        FROM core_record
        GROUP BY clientseg
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)),
     ranked AS
  (SELECT seg,
          dti,
          tdsr,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seg
                             ORDER BY dti) AS rn,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY seg) AS cnt
   FROM filtered),
     per_seg AS
  (SELECT seg,
          COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
          AVG(dti) AS avg_dti,
          AVG(tdsr) AS avg_tdsr,
          AVG(CASE
                  WHEN rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) THEN dti
              END) AS median_dti
   FROM ranked
   GROUP BY seg),
     total_rank AS
  (SELECT dti,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                             ORDER BY dti) AS rn,
          COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
   FROM filtered),
     total AS
  (SELECT 'All Segments' AS seg,

     (SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM filtered) AS num_customers,

     (SELECT AVG(dti)
      FROM filtered) AS avg_dti,

     (SELECT AVG(tdsr)
      FROM filtered) AS avg_tdsr,

     (SELECT AVG(CASE
                     WHEN rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) THEN dti
                 END)
      FROM total_rank) AS median_dti)
SELECT seg AS customer_segment,
       num_customers,
       avg_dti,
       avg_tdsr,
       median_dti
FROM per_seg
UNION ALL
SELECT seg,
       num_customers,
       avg_dti,
       avg_tdsr,
       median_dti
FROM total
ORDER BY (seg = 'All Segments'), avg_tdsr DESC;

SELECT

  ROUND(CASE p.datasense WHEN 'Critical' THEN 4.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS DataSensitivityIndex,
  (CASE WHEN s.encstate='Full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.aclstate='Strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

WHERE p.datasense IN ('Critical','High')

  p.profiletrace AS ProfileTrace,
  ROUND(CASE p.datasense WHEN 'Critical' THEN 4.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS DataSensitivityIndex,
  (CASE WHEN s.encstate='Full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.aclstate='Strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.apisecstate='Secure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.authmeth='MFA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.logintcheck='Passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.bkpstate='Current' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.drecstate='Tested' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.bcstate='Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.keymanstate='Distributed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN s.psymstate='Applied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SecurityRobustnessScore
FROM dataprofile p
JOIN securityprofile s ON s.profilekey = p.profiletrace
WHERE p.datasense IN ('Critical','High')
  AND (s.encstate IS NULL OR s.encstate='Partial')
ORDER BY DataSensitivityIndex DESC, SecurityRobustnessScore ASC
LIMIT 5;"}

  Definition: rebtotal / notionsum * 100

  Definition: rebtotal = feetotal * (rebrate / feerate)

- Notional sum (notionsum): Total value of an order, computed as the quote amount times the quantity.
  Measured: notionsum does not hold dealquote * dealcount in this database
- Fee-to-Notional Ratio (FTNR): Fee amount charged per unit of order notional, expressed as a percentage.

- Rebate-to-Notional Ratio: Rebate earned per unit of order notional, expressed as a percentage.
  Definition: rebtotal / notionsum * 100
- rebate total (rebtotal): Total rebate amount equals total fee amount scaled by the ratio of rebate rate to fee rate.
  Definition: rebtotal = feetotal * (rebrate / feerate)

{"sql": "SELECT
  i.investregistry AS investigation_registry_id,
  ROUND(
    0.40 * i.compliancescore +
    0.25 * (CASE i.lawinterest WHEN 'High' THEN 100 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 60 WHEN 'Low' THEN 30 ELSE 0 END) +
    0.20 * (CASE i.regrisklvl WHEN 'High' THEN 100 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 60 WHEN 'Low' THEN 30 END) +
    0.15 * (CASE i.investpriority WHEN 'High' THEN 100 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 60 WHEN 'Low' THEN 30 END),
    2) AS investigation_priority_score,
  i.lawinterest AS law_enforcement_interest_level,
  t.txregistry AS transaction_id
FROM investigation i
JOIN riskanalysis r ON r.riskregistry = i.riskref
JOIN transactions t ON t.txregistry = r.txref
WHERE i.investpriority = 'High'
  AND i.investstat = 'Active'
ORDER BY investigation_priority_score DESC
LIMIT 20;"}

{"sql": "ALTER TABLE vendors ADD COLUMN vendtrustindex REAL;
UPDATE vendors
SET vendtrustindex = ROUND(
    100.0 * (vendrate / 5.0)
    * (vendsucccount * 1.0 / NULLIF(vendtxcount, 0))
    * (1.0 - venddisputecount * 1.0 / NULLIF(vendtxcount, 0)), 2)
WHERE vendregistry IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.vendref
    FROM products p
    JOIN transactions t ON t.prodref = p.prodregistry
    WHERE t.txstatus = 'Completed'
);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_vendors,
       SUM(CASE WHEN vendtrustindex IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scored_vendors,
       MIN(vendtrustindex) AS min_vti, MAX(vendtrustindex) AS max_vti
FROM vendors;"}

distributionhubs.hubregistry: Unique ID for each distribution hub. Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a distribution hub. Always 8 characters, pattern HUB_ followed by four alphanumeric characters. Used as primary key.
distributionhubs.disteventref: Unique reference for a distribution event. Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a distribution event. Exactly 10 characters, pattern DIST_ followed by five alphanumeric characters. Distinguishes each event.
distributionhubs.hubcaptons: Hub capacity in tons. Numeric value representing storage capacity of hub in tons. Values range from 1012 to 9997, one decimal place. Higher value means more capacity.

WITH farms AS
  (SELECT cntref,
          cntsimscore AS content_manipulation_score,
          postfreq,
          CASE
              WHEN postfreq > 50 THEN 'High'
              WHEN postfreq >= 20 THEN 'Medium'
              ELSE 'Low'
          END AS frequency_category,
          RANK() OVER (
                       ORDER BY cntsimscore DESC) AS manipulation_rank
   FROM contentbehavior)
SELECT cntref,
       content_manipulation_score,
       postfreq,
       frequency_category,
       manipulation_rank
FROM farms
WHERE manipulation_rank <= 10
ORDER BY manipulation_rank
LIMIT 100;

WITH abusers AS
  (SELECT a.acctident AS account_id,
          m.trustval,
          CAST(json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.engagement_metrics.engrate') AS REAL) AS engrate,
          t.ipcountrynum AS num_countries
   FROM ACCOUNT a
   JOIN PROFILE p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
   JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey
   JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref
   JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey
   JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey
   JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref
   JOIN moderationaction m ON m.macntref = c.cntref
   WHERE t.vpnratio > 0.9
     AND json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.overall.threatlvl') = 'High')
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(trustval * engrate, 3) AS tei_value,
       num_countries,
       NTILE(4) OVER (
                      ORDER BY trustval * engrate DESC) AS tei_quartile
FROM abusers
ORDER BY tei_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH abusers AS
  (SELECT a.acctident AS account_id,
          m.trustval,
          CAST(json_extract(n.network_engagement_metrics, '$.engagement_metrics.engrate') AS REAL) AS engrate,
          t.ipcountrynum AS num_countries
   FROM ACCOUNT a
   JOIN PROFILE p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
   JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey
   JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref
   JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey
   JOIN securitydetection sd ON sd.sectechref = t.techkey
   JOIN contentbehavior c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref
   JOIN moderationaction m ON m.macntref = c.cntref
   WHERE t.vpnratio > 0.9
     AND json_extract(sd.detection_score_profile, '$.overall.threatlvl') = 'High')
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(trustval * engrate, 3) AS tei_value,
       num_countries,
       NTILE(4) OVER (
                      ORDER BY trustval * engrate DESC) AS tei_quartile
FROM abusers
ORDER BY tei_value DESC

instances.question: Please create or replace a view named v_account_technical_evasion_risk. This view should calculate the Technical Evasion Index for all accounts, rounding the score to 4 decimal places. When calculating TEI, consider all accounts, even if they lack associated technical info records (use default values like 0 for missing VPN ratio, proxy count, or IP country number). Based on these TEI scores, determine the TEI quartile for each account across the entire dataset. Finally, assign a TEI Risk Category, and the view must output the account index, account identifier, platform type, the calculated TEI score, the TEI quartile number, and the assigned TEI Risk Category.

candidates:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_account_technical_evasion_risk;
CREATE VIEW v_account_technical_evasion_risk AS
WITH tei_calc AS (
  SELECT a.accindex,
         a.acctident,
         a.plattype,
         ROUND((COALESCE(t.vpnratio, 0) + COALESCE(t.proxycount, 0) / 10.0 + COALESCE(t.ipcountrynum, 0) / 50.0) / 3.0, 4) AS tei_score
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
  LEFT JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey
  LEFT JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref
  LEFT JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey
)
SELECT accindex, acctident, plattype, tei_score, tei_quartile,
       CASE tei_quartile
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Low'
         WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium'
         WHEN 3 THEN 'High'
         WHEN 4 THEN 'Critical'
       END AS tei_risk_category
FROM (
  SELECT accindex, acctident, plattype, tei_score,
         NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei_score) AS tei_quartile
  FROM tei_calc
);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, MIN(tei_score) AS min_tei, MAX(tei_score) AS max_tei FROM v_account_technical_evasion_risk;
SELECT tei_quartile, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(tei_score) AS lo, MAX(tei_score) AS hi FROM v_account_technical_evasion_risk GROUP BY tei_quartile ORDER BY tei_quartile;
SELECT * FROM v_account_technical_evasion_risk ORDER BY tei_score LIMIT 8;

         a.acctident,
         a.plattype,
         ROUND((COALESCE(t.vpnratio, 0) + COALESCE(t.proxycount, 0) / 10.0 + COALESCE(t.ipcountrynum, 0) / 50.0) / 3.0, 4) AS tei_score
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
  LEFT JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey
  LEFT JOIN networkmetrics n ON n.netsessref = s.sessref
  LEFT JOIN technicalinfo t ON t.technetref = n.netkey
)
SELECT accindex, acctident, plattype, tei_score, tei_quartile,
       CASE tei_quartile
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Low'
         WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium'
         WHEN 3 THEN 'High'
         WHEN 4 THEN 'Critical'
       END AS tei_risk_category
FROM (
  SELECT accindex, acctident, plattype, tei_score,
         NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei_score) AS tei_quartile
  FROM tei_calc
);

       TRIM(m.clustrole),

       MAX(m.coordscore),

JOIN sessionbehavior s ON s.sessref = c.cntsessref

SELECT d.makername AS manufacturer,
       d.modnum AS model_number,
       d.dpires AS dpi_resolution,
       t.pollratehz AS polling_rate,
       ROUND((d.dpires * 1.0 * t.pollratehz) / 1000000.0, 2) AS sensor_performance_index,
       ROUND(m.ergorate * 1.0 + (100.0 - p.wgtgram) / 10.0 + (p.glidecons - 85.0) / 15.0, 2) AS comfort_index,
       CASE
           WHEN t.pollratehz >= 1000
                AND perf.accelmax >= 40
                AND d.dpires >= 16000 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS premium_gaming_mouse
FROM testsessions t
JOIN deviceidentity d ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
LEFT JOIN performance perf ON perf.perfsessionref = t.sessionregistry
LEFT JOIN physicaldurability p ON p.physperfref = perf.perfregistry
LEFT JOIN mechanical m ON m.mechdevref = d.devregistry
WHERE TRIM(t.devscope) = 'Mouse'
ORDER BY sensor_performance_index DESC,
         comfort_index DESC;

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS premium_gaming_mice AS
SELECT d.devregistry,
       d.makername,
       d.modnum,
       ROUND(d.dpires * 1.0 / d.sensres, 2) AS spi_score,
       m.ergorate AS ci_score,
       CASE
           WHEN ROUND(d.dpires * 1.0 / d.sensres, 2) >= 1.0
                AND m.ergorate >= 80 THEN 'Premium Gaming Mouse'
           ELSE 'Standard Mouse'
       END AS classification
FROM deviceidentity d
JOIN testsessions t ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT mechdevref,
          MAX(ergorate) AS ergorate
   FROM mechanical
   GROUP BY mechdevref) m ON m.mechdevref = d.devregistry
WHERE TRIM(t.devscope) = 'Mouse';

compliancecase.monitint

- Monitoring intensity (MONITINT): Intensity level assigned from alert level. Selects 32% of rows.
  Definition: MONITINT = CASE WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'Critical' THEN 'Intensive' WHEN TRIM(ALERTLVL) = 'High' THEN 'Enhanced' ELSE 'Standard' END
- Alert level (ALERTLVL): Alert level mapped from compliance rating grade. Selects 27% of rows.
  Definition: ALERTLVL = CASE WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'D' THEN 'Critical' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'C' THEN 'High' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'B' THEN 'Medium' WHEN TRIM(COMPRATE) = 'A' THEN 'Low' END
- Compliance rating grade (COMPRATE): Letter grade based on previous violation count. Selects 25% of rows.
  Definition: COMPRATE = CASE WHEN PREVVIOL = 0 THEN 'A' WHEN PREVVIOL BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'B' WHEN PREVVIOL BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 'C' WHEN PREVVIOL >= 5 THEN 'D' END

instances.question: Please create a view called 'trader_omi_distribution' that calculates the Order Modification Intensity (OMI) distribution statistics for all traders in the database. The view should use Common Table Expressions to first calculate OMI values for all valid transactions (where modfreq and cancelpct are not null and cancelpct < 1.0), then implement a manual median calculation using ROW_NUMBER() and window functions. The output should include trader_id, transaction_count, and the key OMI distribution statistics: min_omi, avg_omi, median_omi, and max_omi, grouped by trader reference.

candidates:
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS trader_omi_distribution AS WITH omi_calc AS
  (SELECT t.trdref AS trader_id,
          t.modfreq / (1.0 - t.cancelpct) AS omi
   FROM transactionrecord t
   WHERE t.modfreq IS NOT NULL
     AND t.cancelpct IS NOT NULL
     AND t.cancelpct < 1.0),
                                                          ranked AS
  (SELECT trader_id,
          omi,
          COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_id) AS cnt,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY trader_id
                             ORDER BY omi) AS rn
   FROM omi_calc)
SELECT trader_id,
       cnt AS transaction_count,
       MIN(omi) AS min_omi,
       AVG(omi) AS avg_omi,
       AVG(CASE
               WHEN rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) THEN omi
           END) AS median_omi,
       MAX(omi) AS max_omi
FROM ranked
GROUP BY trader_id,
         cnt;

WITH tes AS
  (SELECT e.patref,
          a.abkey,
          e.timemark,
          f.envstress,
          f.lifeimpact,
          (CASE TRIM(json_extract(tb.therapy_details, '$.engagement'))
               WHEN 'High' THEN 3
               WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
               WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
               WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
           END) AS eng1,
          (CASE TRIM(to2.txeng)
               WHEN 'High' THEN 3
               WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
               WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
               WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
           END) AS eng2
   FROM assessmentbasics a
   JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk sr ON sr.asrkey = a.abkey
   JOIN encounters e ON e.abref = a.abkey
   JOIN facilities f ON f.fackey = e.facid
   JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
   JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
   WHERE sr.suicrisk IN ('High',
                         'Severe')
     AND (f.envstress = 'Severe'
          OR f.lifeimpact = 'Severe'))
SELECT patref AS patient_id,
       abkey AS assessment_id,
       DATE(timemark) AS assessment_date,
       ROUND(AVG((eng1 + eng2) / 2.0)) AS avg_tes,
       envstress,
       lifeimpact
FROM tes
GROUP BY patref,
         abkey,
         timemark,
         envstress,
         lifeimpact
HAVING AVG((eng1 + eng2) / 2.0) < 2
ORDER BY assessment_date DESC
LIMIT 50;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH tes AS (
  SELECT
    e.patref,
    a.abkey,
    e.timemark,
    f.envstress,
    f.lifeimpact,
    (CASE TRIM(json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.engagement')) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END) AS eng1,
    (CASE TRIM(to2.txeng) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END) AS eng2
  FROM assessmentbasics a
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk sr ON sr.asrkey = a.abkey
  JOIN encounters e ON e.abref = a.abkey
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fackey = e.facid
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
  WHERE sr.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe')
    AND (f.envstress = 'Severe' OR f.lifeimpact = 'Severe')
)
SELECT
  patref AS patient_id,
  abkey AS assessment_id,
  DATE(timemark) AS assessment_date,
  ROUND(AVG((eng1 + eng2) / 2.0)) AS avg_tes,
  envstress,
  lifeimpact
FROM tes
GROUP BY patref, abkey, timemark, envstress, lifeimpact
HAVING AVG((eng1 + eng2) / 2.0) < 2
ORDER BY assessment_date DESC
LIMIT 50;"}

WITH tes AS
  (SELECT e.patref,
          a.abkey,
          e.timemark,
          f.envstress,
          f.lifeimpact,
          (CASE TRIM(json_extract(tb.therapy_details, '$.engagement'))
               WHEN 'High' THEN 3
               WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
               WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
               WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
           END) AS eng1,
          (CASE TRIM(to2.txeng)
               WHEN 'High' THEN 3
               WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
               WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
               WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
           END) AS eng2
   FROM assessmentbasics a
   JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk sr ON sr.asrkey = a.abkey
   JOIN encounters e ON e.abref = a.abkey
   JOIN facilities f ON f.fackey = e.facid
   JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
   JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
   WHERE sr.suicrisk IN ('High',

          OR f.lifeimpact = 'Severe'))
SELECT patref AS patient_id,
       abkey AS assessment_id,
       DATE(timemark) AS assessment_date,
       ROUND(AVG((eng1 + eng2) / 2.0)) AS avg_tes,
       envstress,

FROM tes

WITH per_fac AS
  (SELECT f.fackey AS facility,
          CASE json_extract(f.support_and_resources, '$.community_resources')
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
              ELSE 1
          END AS resource_adequacy_index,
          AVG(CASE
                  WHEN TRIM(to2.txadh) = 'High' THEN 1.0
                  ELSE 0.0
              END) AS tar
   FROM facilities f
   JOIN encounters e ON e.facid = f.fackey
   JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
   JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
   GROUP BY f.fackey
   HAVING COUNT(to2.txref) > 0),
     stats AS
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
          SUM(resource_adequacy_index) AS sx,
          SUM(tar) AS sy,
          SUM(resource_adequacy_index*resource_adequacy_index) AS sx2,
          SUM(tar*tar) AS sy2,
          SUM(resource_adequacy_index*tar) AS sxy
   FROM per_fac)
SELECT p.facility,
       p.resource_adequacy_index,
       ROUND((s.n*s.sxy - s.sx*s.sy) / SQRT((s.n*s.sx2 - s.sx*s.sx)*(s.n*s.sy2 - s.sy*s.sy)), 4) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM per_fac p
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY p.facility

{"sql": "WITH per_fac AS (
  SELECT f.fackey AS facility,
         CASE json_extract(f.support_and_resources, '$.community_resources')
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS resource_adequacy_index,
         AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(to2.txadh) = 'High' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS tar
  FROM facilities f
  JOIN encounters e ON e.facid = f.fackey
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
  GROUP BY f.fackey
  HAVING COUNT(to2.txref) > 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
         SUM(resource_adequacy_index) AS sx,
         SUM(tar) AS sy,
         SUM(resource_adequacy_index*resource_adequacy_index) AS sx2,
         SUM(tar*tar) AS sy2,
         SUM(resource_adequacy_index*tar) AS sxy
  FROM per_fac
)
SELECT p.facility, p.resource_adequacy_index, ROUND(p.tar,4) AS tar,
       ROUND((s.n*s.sxy - s.sx*s.sy) / SQRT((s.n*s.sx2 - s.sx*s.sx)*(s.n*s.sy2 - s.sy*s.sy)), 4) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM per_fac p CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY p.facility
LIMIT 10"}

{"sql": "WITH scores AS (
  SELECT e.facid,
    CASE TRIM(o.txeng) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tes,
    CASE TRIM(o.txresp) WHEN 'Good' THEN 2 WHEN 'Partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rti
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = t.txkey
)
SELECT facid AS facility_id, ROUND(AVG(tes),2) AS avg_tes, ROUND(AVG(rti),2) AS avg_rti
FROM scores
GROUP BY facid
HAVING AVG(tes) >= 2 AND AVG(rti) <= 1
ORDER BY facid
LIMIT 100;"}

{"sql": "WITH clinician_psm AS (
  SELECT c.clinkey AS clinician_id,
         c.facconnect AS facility_id,
         ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.housestable = 'Stable' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS psm
  FROM clinicians c
  JOIN patients p ON p.clinleadref = c.clinkey
  GROUP BY c.clinkey, c.facconnect
)
SELECT clinician_id,
       facility_id,
       psm,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY facility_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS rnk
FROM clinician_psm
WHERE facility_id IN (
  SELECT fackey FROM facilities
  WHERE TRIM(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services')) != ''
    AND json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services') NOT LIKE '%None%'
)
ORDER BY facility_id, rnk
LIMIT 100;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH scored AS (
  SELECT
    e.enckey,
    e.timemark,
    tb.txkey,
    json_extract(tb.therapy_details, '$.changes') AS change_type,
    CASE TRIM(json_extract(tb.therapy_details, '$.engagement'))
      WHEN 'High' THEN 0
      WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Low' THEN 2
      WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 3
    END AS eng_score
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    change_type,
    eng_score,
    LAG(eng_score) OVER (ORDER BY e.timemark, e.enckey) AS prev_score
  FROM scored s
  JOIN encounters e ON e.enckey = s.enckey
)
SELECT
  change_type,
  COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
  ROUND(AVG(prev_score), 4) AS avg_score_before,
  ROUND(AVG(eng_score), 4) AS avg_score_after,
  ROUND(AVG(eng_score - prev_score), 4) AS avg_score_change
FROM with_prev
WHERE change_type IS NOT NULL AND prev_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY change_type
ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC;"}

  JOIN encounters e ON e.facid = f.fackey

         CASE
           WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services'), '')) = '' THEN 0
           ELSE LENGTH(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services')) -
                LENGTH(REPLACE(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services'), ',', '')) + 1
         END AS pfis
  FROM facilities
)
SELECT r.facility_id,
       res.pfis,
       ROUND(r.frai, 2) AS frai,
       ROUND(r.frai - res.pfis, 2) AS rdd
FROM risk r
JOIN res ON res.fackey = r.facility_id
WHERE r.frai > 20
ORDER BY rdd DESC
LIMIT 100;"}

WITH risk AS
  (SELECT f.fackey AS facility_id,
          100.0 * SUM(CASE
                          WHEN TRIM(sr.suicrisk) IN ('High', 'Severe') THEN 1
                          ELSE 0
                      END) / COUNT(*) AS frai
   FROM facilities f
   JOIN encounters e ON e.facid = f.fackey
   JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
   JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk sr ON sr.asrkey = ab.abkey
   GROUP BY f.fackey),
     res AS
  (SELECT fackey,
          CASE
              WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services'), '')) = '' THEN 0
              ELSE LENGTH(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.support_services'), ',', '')) + 1
          END AS pfis
   FROM facilities)
SELECT r.facility_id,
       res.pfis,
       ROUND(r.frai, 2) AS frai,
       ROUND(r.frai - res.pfis, 2) AS rdd
FROM risk r
JOIN res ON res.fackey = r.facility_id
WHERE r.frai > 20
ORDER BY rdd DESC
LIMIT 100;

         CASE WHEN TRIM(c.budgetallocstatus) = 'Adequate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS adeq,

       SUM(adeq) AS adequate_funding_count,
       SUM(insuff) AS insufficient_funding_count,
       ROUND(SUM(adeq) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(insuff), 0), 2) AS cbe_value,
       CASE WHEN SUM(insuff) > SUM(adeq) THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END AS budget_status
FROM base

       ROUND(s.moldriskidx + s.organicdegradidx + s.metalcorroderate + s.colorchangedeltae + s.dustaccummgm2 + s.noisedb + s.vibralvlmms2 + (aq.tvocppb + aq.ozoneppb + aq.so2ppb + aq.no2ppb) + l.uvuwcm2, 2) AS tetl_score

Only include segments with more than 10 users, and show me the group's subscription type, gender, occupation, age group bucket ('Under 25', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+'), number of users, average USV, average UDS, average satisfaction score, and the shared interests as a comma-separated list. Return the top 15 groups ranked by average USV (descending), and break ties using average UDS.

WITH user_level AS (
  SELECT userkey,
         TRIM(substatus) AS substatus,
         TRIM(gendlbl) AS gendlbl,
         TRIM(occulbl) AS occulbl,
         CASE WHEN ageval < 25 THEN 'Under 25'
              WHEN ageval <= 34 THEN '25-34'
              WHEN ageval <= 44 THEN '35-44'
              WHEN ageval <= 54 THEN '45-54'
              ELSE '55+' END AS age_group,
         subdays AS usv,
         ageval AS uds,
         CAST(json_extract(user_preferences, '$.satisfaction_score') AS REAL) AS satisfaction_score
  FROM users
),
interests AS (
  SELECT u.userkey,
         TRIM(j.value) AS interest
  FROM users u,
       json_each('["' || replace(json_extract(u.user_preferences, '$.interests'), ',', '","') || '"]') j
),
interest_groups AS (
  SELECT ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group,
         group_concat(DISTINCT i.interest) AS shared_interests
  FROM interests i
  JOIN user_level ul ON ul.userkey = i.userkey
  GROUP BY ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group
)
SELECT ul.substatus,
       ul.gendlbl,
       ul.occulbl,
       ul.age_group,
       COUNT(*) AS num_users,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.usv), 2) AS avg_usv,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.uds), 2) AS avg_uds,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.satisfaction_score), 2) AS avg_satisfaction_score,
       ig.shared_interests
FROM user_level ul
JOIN interest_groups ig
  ON ig.substatus = ul.substatus AND ig.gendlbl = ul.gendlbl
 AND ig.occulbl = ul.occulbl AND ig.age_group = ul.age_group
GROUP BY ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY avg_usv DESC, avg_uds DESC
LIMIT 15;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH user_level AS (
  SELECT userkey,
         TRIM(substatus) AS substatus,
         TRIM(gendlbl) AS gendlbl,
         TRIM(occulbl) AS occulbl,
         CASE WHEN ageval < 25 THEN 'Under 25'
              WHEN ageval <= 34 THEN '25-34'
              WHEN ageval <= 44 THEN '35-44'
              WHEN ageval <= 54 THEN '45-54'
              ELSE '55+' END AS age_group,
         subdays AS usv,
         ageval AS uds,
         CAST(json_extract(user_preferences, '$.satisfaction_score') AS REAL) AS satisfaction_score
  FROM users
),
interests AS (
  SELECT u.userkey,
         TRIM(j.value) AS interest
  FROM users u,
       json_each('["' || replace(json_extract(u.user_preferences, '$.interests'), ',', '","') || '"]') j
),
interest_groups AS (
  SELECT ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group,
         group_concat(DISTINCT i.interest) AS shared_interests
  FROM interests i
  JOIN user_level ul ON ul.userkey = i.userkey
  GROUP BY ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group
)
SELECT ul.substatus,
       ul.gendlbl,
       ul.occulbl,
       ul.age_group,
       COUNT(*) AS num_users,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.usv), 2) AS avg_usv,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.uds), 2) AS avg_uds,
       ROUND(AVG(ul.satisfaction_score), 2) AS avg_satisfaction_score,
       ig.shared_interests
FROM user_level ul
JOIN interest_groups ig
  ON ig.substatus = ul.substatus AND ig.gendlbl = ul.gendlbl
 AND ig.occulbl = ul.occulbl AND ig.age_group = ul.age_group
GROUP BY ul.substatus, ul.gendlbl, ul.occulbl, ul.age_group
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY avg_usv DESC, avg_uds DESC
LIMIT 15;"}

         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(AVG(ars),2) AS avg_readability_score,
         ROUND(AVG(engagement_rate),4) AS avg_engagement_rate,
         ROUND((COUNT(*)*SUM(ars*engagement_rate) - SUM(ars)*SUM(engagement_rate)) /

                    (COUNT(*)*SUM(engagement_rate*engagement_rate) - SUM(engagement_rate)*SUM(engagement_rate))),4) AS correlation_coefficient,

         SUM(CASE WHEN readability_group='high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_readability_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY catlabel
)
SELECT catlabel, avg_readability_score, avg_engagement_rate, correlation_coefficient,
       low_readability_count, medium_readability_count, high_readability_count

function.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT
  e.equipmentcode,
  e.equipmenttype,
  ce.heaterstatus,
  t.insulationstatus,
  l.emergencylightstatus,
  ROUND(100.0 / w.structuralloadpercent, 2) AS structuralsafetyfactor,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(ce.heaterstatus) = 'On'
        AND TRIM(t.insulationstatus) = 'Good'
        AND TRIM(l.emergencylightstatus) = 'On'
        AND TRIM(w.structuralintegritystatus) = 'Normal'
       THEN 'Ready' ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS extremeweatherreadinessstatus
FROM weatherandstructure w
JOIN location loc ON loc.locationregistry = w.weatherlocref
JOIN equipment e ON e.equipmentcode = loc.loceqref
LEFT JOIN cabinenvironment ce ON ce.cabineqref = e.equipmentcode
LEFT JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode
LEFT JOIN lightingandsafety l ON l.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
ORDER BY e.equipmentcode;"}

       ROUND(SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.wind.output_w')), 2) AS total_renewable_output_w,
       CASE
           WHEN 100.0 * (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.wind.output_w'))) / (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.wind.output_w')) + SUM(t.fuelcelloutputw)) >= 70 THEN 'High'

           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS energy_sustainability_classification
FROM thermalsolarwindandgrid t
JOIN LOCATION l ON l.loceqref = t.thermaleqref

function.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT
  l.locationtype,
  l.stationname,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.thermaleqref) AS equipment_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w'))) /
        (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w')) + SUM(t.fuelcelloutputw)), 2) AS rec,
  ROUND(SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w')), 2) AS total_renewable_w,
  CASE
    WHEN 100.0 * (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w'))) /
         (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w')) + SUM(t.fuelcelloutputw)) >= 70 THEN 'High'
    WHEN 100.0 * (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w'))) /
         (SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.solar.output_w')) + SUM(json_extract(t.renewablemetrics,'$.wind.output_w')) + SUM(t.fuelcelloutputw)) >= 40 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS escs
FROM thermalsolarwindandgrid t
JOIN location l ON l.loceqref = t.thermaleqref
GROUP BY l.locationtype, l.stationname
ORDER BY rec DESC
LIMIT 10;"}

WITH stats AS
  (SELECT MIN(json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.radio_strength_dbm')) AS min_rssi,
          MAX(json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.radio_strength_dbm')) AS max_rssi,
          MIN(json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.latency_ms')) AS min_lat,
          MAX(json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.latency_ms')) AS max_lat
   FROM communication),
     comm AS
  (SELECT c.commregistry,
          c.antennastatus,
          json_extract(c.signalmetrics, '$.radio_strength_dbm') AS radio_strength_dbm,
          json_extract(c.signalmetrics, '$.latency_ms') AS latency_ms,
          CASE TRIM(c.antennastatus)
              WHEN 'Normal' THEN 1.0
              WHEN 'Warning' THEN 0.5
              ELSE 0.0
          END AS antenna_score,
          (json_extract(c.signalmetrics, '$.radio_strength_dbm') - s.min_rssi) / (s.max_rssi - s.min_rssi) AS rssi_norm,
          1.0 - (json_extract(c.signalmetrics, '$.latency_ms') - s.min_lat) / (s.max_lat - s.min_lat) AS latency_score

       ROUND(100.0 * (0.4 * antenna_score + 0.3 * rssi_norm + 0.3 * latency_score), 2) AS bscsi
FROM comm
ORDER BY commregistry;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH stats AS (
  SELECT MIN(json_extract(signalmetrics,'$.radio_strength_dbm')) AS min_rssi,
         MAX(json_extract(signalmetrics,'$.radio_strength_dbm')) AS max_rssi,

  FROM communication
),
comm AS (
  SELECT c.commregistry,
         c.antennastatus,
         json_extract(c.signalmetrics,'$.radio_strength_dbm') AS radio_strength_dbm,
         json_extract(c.signalmetrics,'$.latency_ms') AS latency_ms,
         CASE TRIM(c.antennastatus)
              WHEN 'Normal'  THEN 1.0
              WHEN 'Warning' THEN 0.5
              ELSE 0.0
         END AS antenna_score,
         (json_extract(c.signalmetrics,'$.radio_strength_dbm') - s.min_rssi) / (s.max_rssi - s.min_rssi) AS rssi_norm,
         1.0 - (json_extract(c.signalmetrics,'$.latency_ms') - s.min_lat) / (s.max_lat - s.min_lat) AS latency_score
  FROM communication c
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT commregistry,

FROM comm
ORDER BY commregistry
LIMIT 10;"}

SET reliabilityindex = reliabilityindex * 1.15
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cabinenvironment ce
  WHERE ce.cabineqref = equipment.equipmentcode
    AND json_extract(ce.cabinclimate, '$.co2_ppm') < 1000
    AND json_extract(ce.cabinclimate, '$.o2_percent') >= 19.5
    AND json_extract(ce.cabinclimate, '$.pressure_kpa') BETWEEN 950 AND 1050

    AND json_extract(ce.cabinclimate, '$.humidity_percent') BETWEEN 30 AND 70
    AND json_extract(ce.cabinclimate, '$.air_quality_index') <= 100
);

  SELECT 1 FROM cabinenvironment ce

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH calc AS (
  SELECT watereqref,
    ROUND((waterlevelpercent + waterqualityindex/10.0 + waterpressurekpa/10.0 + waterflowlpm/10.0 + (100.0 - wastetanklevelpercent)) / 5.0, 2) AS wrmi
  FROM waterandwaste
  WHERE waterlevelpercent IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(wrmi) AS min_wrmi, MAX(wrmi) AS max_wrmi, AVG(wrmi) AS avg_wrmi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wrmi >= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ge70,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wrmi >= 50 AND wrmi < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ge50_lt70,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wrmi < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lt50
FROM calc;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS water_management_view AS
WITH calc AS (
  SELECT watereqref,
         (waterlevelpercent + waterqualityindex/10.0 + waterpressurekpa/10.0 + waterflowlpm/10.0 + (100.0 - wastetanklevelpercent)) / 5.0 AS wrmi
  FROM waterandwaste
  WHERE waterlevelpercent IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT watereqref,
       ROUND(wrmi, 2) AS wrmi,
       CASE
         WHEN wrmi >= 70 THEN 'Normal'
         WHEN wrmi >= 50 THEN 'Warning'
         ELSE 'Critical'
       END AS water_management_status
FROM calc;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT watereqref) AS distinct_eq FROM water_management_view;

instances.question: I want to analyze robot efficiency by model series, focusing on Operation Cycle Efficiency, Total Program Cycles, and Average Cycle Time. For each model series with at least 5 robots, list the model series name, number of robots, average OCE and average number of programs per robot rounded to 2 decimal place, average TPC, and Efficiency Metrics as a JSON object containing the most efficient program (by Program Efficiency Rank) and the average OCE across all programs. Also, count robots with Cycle Efficiency Category of 'Low Efficiency'. Sort by average OCE from highest to lowest and limit to 50 rows.

verdict.error: Test case errors: Test case failed due to assertion error: ex_base returned 0 but expected 1.

candidates:
SELECT d.modelseriesval,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
       ROUND(AVG(p.effectivenessindexval), 2) AS average_oce,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg), 2) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
       AVG(o.progcyclecount) AS average_tpc,
       json_object('most_efficient_program',
                     (SELECT o2.currprogval
                      FROM OPERATION o2
                      JOIN performance_and_safety p2 ON p2.effectivenessoperation = o2.operreg
                      JOIN robot_details d2 ON d2.botdetreg = o2.operbotdetref
                      WHERE d2.modelseriesval = d.modelseriesval
                      ORDER BY p2.effectivenessindexval DESC, o2.currprogval
                      LIMIT 1), 'average_oce_all_programs', ROUND(
                                                                    (SELECT AVG(p3.effectivenessindexval)
                                                                     FROM OPERATION o3
                                                                     JOIN performance_and_safety p3 ON p3.effectivenessoperation = o3.operreg
                                                                     JOIN robot_details d3 ON d3.botdetreg = o3.operbotdetref
                                                                     WHERE d3.modelseriesval = d.modelseriesval), 2)) AS efficiency_metrics,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN p.effectivenessindexval < 0.5 THEN d.botdetreg
                      END) AS low_efficiency_robot_count
FROM robot_details d
JOIN OPERATION o ON o.operbotdetref = d.botdetreg
JOIN performance_and_safety p ON p.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg
GROUP BY d.modelseriesval
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg) >= 5
ORDER BY average_oce DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.modelseriesval,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
       ROUND(AVG(p.effectivenessindexval), 2) AS average_oce,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.currprogval) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg), 2) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
       AVG(o.progcyclecount) AS average_tpc,
       json_object('most_efficient_program',
                     (SELECT o2.currprogval
                      FROM OPERATION o2
                      JOIN performance_and_safety p2 ON p2.effectivenessoperation = o2.operreg
                      JOIN robot_details d2 ON d2.botdetreg = o2.operbotdetref
                      WHERE d2.modelseriesval = d.modelseriesval
                      ORDER BY p2.effectivenessindexval DESC, o2.currprogval
                      LIMIT 1), 'average_oce_all_programs', ROUND(
                                                                    (SELECT AVG(p3.effectivenessindexval)
                                                                     FROM OPERATION o3
                                                                     JOIN performance_and_safety p3 ON p3.effectivenessoperation = o3.operreg
                                                                     JOIN robot_details d3 ON d3.botdetreg = o3.operbotdetref
                                                                     WHERE d3.modelseriesval = d.modelseriesval), 2)) AS efficiency_metrics,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN p.effectivenessindexval < 0.5 THEN d.botdetreg
                      END) AS low_efficiency_robot_count
FROM robot_details d
JOIN OPERATION o ON o.operbotdetref = d.botdetreg
JOIN performance_and_safety p ON p.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg
GROUP BY d.modelseriesval
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.botdetreg) >= 5
ORDER BY average_oce DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH qual AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT upkeeprobot AS robot_id
   FROM maintenance_and_fault
   WHERE faulttypeestimation = 'Joint'),
     base AS
  (SELECT rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
          ps.conditionindexval AS jdi,
          MAX(jc.j1tempval, jc.j2tempval, jc.j3tempval, jc.j4tempval, jc.j5tempval, jc.j6tempval) AS max_joint_temp,
          op.totopshrval AS toh
   FROM qual q
   JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = q.robot_id
   JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
   JOIN joint_condition jc ON jc.jcdetref = rd.botdetreg
   JOIN OPERATION op ON op.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg)
SELECT b.robot_id,
       b.jdi,
       b.max_joint_temp,
       b.toh,
       (COUNT(*) OVER () * SUM(b.toh * b.jdi) OVER () - SUM(b.toh) OVER () * SUM(b.jdi) OVER ()) / (COUNT(*) OVER () * SUM(b.toh * b.toh) OVER () - SUM(b.toh) OVER () * SUM(b.toh) OVER ()) AS slope
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.jdi DESC
LIMIT 100;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT TRIM(b.bottypeval) AS robot_type,
       AVG(s.sis) AS avg_sis,
       MAX(s.sis) AS max_sis
FROM (
  SELECT p.effectivenessrobot AS robot,
         COALESCE(json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.overloads'), 0)
       + COALESCE(json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.collisions'), 0)
       + COALESCE(json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.emergency_stops'), 0)
       + COALESCE(json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.zone_violations'), 0)
       + COALESCE(json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.speed_violations'), 0) AS sis,
         json_extract(p.safety_metrics, '$.safety_state') AS safety_state
  FROM performance_and_safety p
) s
JOIN robot_details b ON s.robot = b.botdetreg
WHERE s.safety_state = 'Emergency' AND s.sis > 20
GROUP BY TRIM(b.bottypeval)
ORDER BY AVG(s.sis) DESC
LIMIT 100;"}

SELECT d.botdetreg AS robot_id,
       AVG(p.toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_wear_pct,
       p.toolwearpct AS twr_value,
       o.progcyclecount AS tpc_value,
       AVG(o.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_sec,
       CASE
           WHEN p.toolwearpct >= 90 THEN 'Replace'
           WHEN p.toolwearpct >= 70 THEN 'Monitor'
           ELSE 'OK'
       END AS tool_replacement_status
FROM robot_details d
JOIN performance_and_safety p ON p.effectivenessrobot = d.botdetreg
JOIN OPERATION o ON o.operbotdetref = d.botdetreg
GROUP BY d.botdetreg
ORDER BY p.toolwearpct DESC,
         o.progcyclecount DESC
LIMIT 100;

instances.question: Analyze robots' cycle efficiency category, where for each robot, show its ID, model series, OCE value, TPC value, average cycle time, number of unique programs, most recent cycle time, and efficiency category. Also, show each robot's efficiency ranking within its model series. Only include robots with over 100,000 program cycles. Show top 100 robots ordered by OCE (highest first) then by TPC.

WITH op_robot AS
  (SELECT rd.botdetreg,
          rd.modelseriesval,
          op.totopshrval,
          op.progcyclecount,
          op.cycletimesecval,
          op.currprogval
   FROM robot_details rd
   JOIN OPERATION op ON op.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg),
     agg AS
  (SELECT botdetreg,
          modelseriesval,
          SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc,
          SUM(progcyclecount) / SUM(totopshrval) AS oce,
          AVG(cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
          COUNT(DISTINCT currprogval) AS unique_programs,
          MAX(cycletimesecval) AS most_recent_cycle_time
   FROM op_robot
   GROUP BY botdetreg,
            modelseriesval
   HAVING SUM(progcyclecount) > 100000)
SELECT botdetreg,
       modelseriesval,
       oce,
       tpc,
       avg_cycle_time,
       unique_programs,
       most_recent_cycle_time,
       CASE NTILE(3) OVER (
                           ORDER BY oce DESC)
           WHEN 1 THEN 'High'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS efficiency_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval
                    ORDER BY oce DESC) AS efficiency_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY oce DESC,
         tpc DESC
LIMIT 100;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH op_robot AS (
  SELECT rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, op.totopshrval, op.progcyclecount, op.cycletimesecval, op.currprogval
  FROM robot_details rd JOIN operation op ON op.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
),
agg AS (
  SELECT botdetreg, modelseriesval,
    SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc,
    SUM(progcyclecount) / SUM(totopshrval) AS oce,
    AVG(cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT currprogval) AS unique_programs,
    MAX(cycletimesecval) AS most_recent_cycle_time
  FROM op_robot
  GROUP BY botdetreg, modelseriesval
  HAVING SUM(progcyclecount) > 100000
)
SELECT botdetreg, modelseriesval, oce, tpc, avg_cycle_time, unique_programs, most_recent_cycle_time,
  CASE NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY oce DESC) WHEN 1 THEN 'High' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS efficiency_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval ORDER BY oce DESC) AS efficiency_rank
FROM agg
ORDER BY oce DESC, tpc DESC
LIMIT 100;"}

WITH op_robot AS
  (SELECT rd.botdetreg,
          rd.modelseriesval,
          op.totopshrval,
          op.progcyclecount,
          op.cycletimesecval,
          op.currprogval
   FROM robot_details rd
   JOIN OPERATION op ON op.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg),
     agg AS
  (SELECT botdetreg,
          modelseriesval,
          SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc,

  SELECT actdetref AS robot, AVG(poserrmmval) AS avg_pos_err
  FROM actuation_data GROUP BY actdetref

  SELECT robot, avg_pos_err,

  FROM ape
)

       AVG(r.avg_pos_err) AS avg_average_position_error,
       MAX(r.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank,
       AVG(m.faultpredscore) AS avg_recent_fault_prediction_score,
       COUNT(*) AS robot_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = r.robot
JOIN maintenance_and_fault m ON m.upkeeprobot = r.robot
WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(d.instdateval)) / 365.25 > 1
  AND r.avg_pos_err >= 0.167
  AND m.faultpredscore > 0.66
GROUP BY d.ctrltypeval
ORDER BY max_ape_rank DESC
LIMIT 50;"}

WITH ape AS
  (SELECT actdetref AS robot,
          AVG(poserrmmval) AS avg_pos_err
   FROM actuation_data
   GROUP BY actdetref),
     ranked AS
  (SELECT robot,
          avg_pos_err,
          RANK() OVER (
                       ORDER BY avg_pos_err) AS ape_rank
   FROM ape)
SELECT d.ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
       AVG(r.avg_pos_err) AS avg_average_position_error,
       MAX(r.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank,
       AVG(m.faultpredscore) AS avg_recent_fault_prediction_score,
       COUNT(*) AS robot_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN robot_details d ON d.botdetreg = r.robot
JOIN maintenance_and_fault m ON m.upkeeprobot = r.robot
WHERE (julianday('now') - julianday(d.instdateval)) / 365.25 > 1
  AND r.avg_pos_err >= 0.167
  AND m.faultpredscore > 0.66
GROUP BY d.ctrltypeval
ORDER BY max_ape_rank DESC
LIMIT 50;

           WHEN AVG(faultpredscore) >= 0.7 THEN 'CRITICAL'

WITH plant_metrics AS
  (SELECT p.growregistry,
          p.growalias AS plant_name,
          p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
          SUM(m.maintcostusd) AS total_maintenance_costs,
          SUM(m.revlossusd) AS revenue_losses,
          SUM(m.maintcostusd) / p.gencapmw AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
          SUM(m.revlossusd) / p.gencapmw AS revenue_loss_rate,
          SUM(m.revlossusd) / NULLIF(SUM(m.maintcostusd), 0) AS mroi_value
   FROM plant p
   JOIN maintenance m ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
   GROUP BY p.growregistry)
SELECT pm.plant_name,
       ROUND(pm.capacity_mw, 2) AS capacity_mw,
       ROUND(pm.total_maintenance_costs, 2) AS total_maintenance_costs,
       ROUND(pm.revenue_losses, 2) AS revenue_losses,
       ROUND(pm.maintenance_cost_efficiency_score, 4) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency_score,
       ROUND(pm.revenue_loss_rate, 4) AS revenue_loss_rate,
       ROUND(pm.mroi_value, 4) AS mroi_value,
       CASE
           WHEN a.maintprior = 'High'
                AND a.alertstat = 'Critical' THEN 'URGENT'
           WHEN a.maintprior = 'High' THEN 'HIGH'
           WHEN a.maintprior = 'Medium' THEN 'MEDIUM'
           ELSE 'LOW'
       END AS priority_level
FROM plant_metrics pm
JOIN alerts a ON a.compreg = pm.growregistry
ORDER BY CASE
             WHEN a.maintprior = 'High'
                  AND a.alertstat = 'Critical' THEN 0

instances.question: Create a trigger named 'generate_performance_alert_trigger' that automatically fires after new performance data is inserted into the performance table. This trigger should monitor for panels falling below the Critical Performance Threshold (assuming 0.7% annual degradation) and generate Critical Performance Alerts according to our standard Alert Specification Protocol. The trigger should calculate panel age using date functions, determine actual vs. expected performance ratios, and insert new alerts when performance drops below 80% of expected value. Additionally, implement duplicate handling by checking for existing critical alerts within the last 30 days and updating alert counts instead of creating new alerts when duplicates are detected. Use appropriate SQLite date functions and conditional logic within the trigger body.

candidates:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS generate_performance_alert_trigger AFTER
INSERT ON performance
FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.measpoww < 0.80 *
  (SELECT p.powratew * (1 - 0.007 * ((julianday(NEW.perfmoment) - julianday(pl.initdate)) / 365.25))
   FROM panel p
   JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
   WHERE p.panemark = NEW.solmodref) BEGIN
UPDATE alerts
SET alertcnt = alertcnt + 1
WHERE deviceref = NEW.solmodref
  AND alertstat = 'Critical'
  AND alertmoment >= datetime(NEW.perfmoment, '-30 days');
  INSERT INTO alerts (alertreg, compreg, deviceref, incidentref, alertmoment, alertstat, alertcnt, maintprior, replaceprior, optpotential)
SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))),
       pl.growregistry,
       NEW.solmodref,
       NEW.perfregistry,
       NEW.perfmoment,
       'Critical',
       1,
       'High',
       'High',
       'High'
FROM panel p
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
WHERE p.panemark = NEW.solmodref
  AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM alerts a
     WHERE a.deviceref = NEW.solmodref
       AND a.alertstat = 'Critical'
       AND a.alertmoment >= datetime(NEW.perfmoment, '-30 days')); END;

{"sql": "CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS generate_performance_alert_trigger
AFTER INSERT ON performance
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.measpoww < 0.80 * (
        SELECT p.powratew * (1 - 0.007 * ((julianday(NEW.perfmoment) - julianday(pl.initdate)) / 365.25))
        FROM panel p
        JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
        WHERE p.panemark = NEW.solmodref
     )
BEGIN
    UPDATE alerts
    SET alertcnt = alertcnt + 1
    WHERE deviceref = NEW.solmodref
      AND alertstat = 'Critical'
      AND alertmoment >= datetime(NEW.perfmoment, '-30 days');

    INSERT INTO alerts (alertreg, compreg, deviceref, incidentref, alertmoment, alertstat, alertcnt, maintprior, replaceprior, optpotential)
    SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))),
        pl.growregistry,
        NEW.solmodref,
        NEW.perfregistry,
        NEW.perfmoment,
        'Critical',
        1,
        'High',
        'High',
        'High'
    FROM panel p
    JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
    WHERE p.panemark = NEW.solmodref
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM alerts a
          WHERE a.deviceref = NEW.solmodref
            AND a.alertstat = 'Critical'
            AND a.alertmoment >= datetime(NEW.perfmoment, '-30 days')
      );
END;

SELECT deviceref, incidentref, alertmoment, alertstat, alertcnt FROM alerts WHERE deviceref = 'e00b3472-780b-490f-941b-a4f298882d7f' AND alertstat = 'Critical';

{"sql": "SELECT 
  ti.transmode AS mode_name,
  ROUND(AVG(1.0 - sd.critevents * 1.0 / sd.handleevents), 3) AS avg_handling_quality_index,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ti.vehiclereg) AS vehicles_involved,
  COUNT(*) AS stable_transport_count
FROM sensordata sd
JOIN transportinfo ti ON ti.vehiclereg = sd.vehsenseref
JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipmentregistry = ti.shiptransit
WHERE TRIM(sd.shockflag) = 'Normal'
  AND TRIM(sd.tiltflag) = 'Normal'
  AND TRIM(sd.impactflag) = 'Normal'
  AND sh.timemark >= datetime((SELECT MAX(timemark) FROM shipments), '-3 months')
  AND sd.handleevents > 0
GROUP BY ti.transmode
HAVING AVG(1.0 - sd.critevents * 1.0 / sd.handleevents) > 0
ORDER BY AVG(1.0 - sd.critevents * 1.0 / sd.handleevents) DESC
LIMIT 10;"}

{"sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.containregistry AS container_id,
    ROUND(MAX(s.tempstabidx), 3) AS temp_stability_score,
    ROUND((100 - COALESCE(MAX(r.compscore), 0)) / 100.0, 3) AS container_risk_index,
    CASE WHEN MAX(s.containlink) IS NULL THEN 'No Sensor Data' ELSE 'Sensor Data Available' END AS sensor_status,
    MAX(s.tempdevcount) AS temp_dev_count,
    MAX(s.critevents) AS crit_events,
    MAX(s.tempstabidx) AS temp_stab_idx,
    MAX(c.coolremainpct) AS cool_remain_pct,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.containlink IS NOT NULL THEN s.tempmaxc - (s.storetempc + s.temptolc) END) AS breach_raw
  FROM container c
  LEFT JOIN sensordata s ON c.containregistry = s.containlink
  LEFT JOIN shipments sh ON sh.shipmentregistry = c.shipown
  LEFT JOIN regulatoryandmaintenance r ON r.shipgov = sh.shipmentregistry
  GROUP BY c.containregistry
)
SELECT
  container_id,
  temp_stability_score,
  container_risk_index,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY container_risk_index DESC) AS risk_rank,
  sensor_status,
  json_object(
    'TempDevCount', temp_dev_count,
    'CritEvents', crit_events,
    'TempStabIdx', temp_stab_idx,
    'CoolRemainPct', cool_remain_pct,
    'TempBreachSeverity', CASE WHEN breach_raw IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN breach_raw < 0 THEN 0 ELSE breach_raw END
  ) AS diagnostic_json
FROM base
ORDER BY risk_rank ASC
LIMIT 10;"}

       MAX(c.coolremainpct) AS max_coolant_remaining_pct
FROM transportinfo t
JOIN sensordata s ON s.vehsenseref = t.vehiclereg
JOIN container c ON c.containregistry = t.containtransit
JOIN regulatoryandmaintenance r ON r.vehgov = t.vehiclereg
WHERE TRIM(r.riskflag) = 'High Risk'
GROUP BY t.vehiclereg, t.shiptransit
ORDER BY max_container_risk_index DESC
LIMIT 10;

{"sql": "DROP VIEW IF EXISTS container_depletion_rank_view;
CREATE VIEW container_depletion_rank_view AS

  containregistry,
  containmodel,
  coolremainpct,
  refilllatest,
  ROUND((100.0 - coolremainpct) / (julianday(refillnext) - julianday(refilllatest)), 4) AS coolant_depletion_rate,

Only include fans who meet all the Community Pillar criteria. Sort the results by CCI score in descending order.

candidates:
SELECT f.nicklabel,
       ROUND((CAST(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ugcval') AS REAL) + json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.artsubs') + json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.ficsubs') + json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.coverperfcnt') + json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grpmemb') + json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contqualrate')) / 6.0, 2) AS cci,
       json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grprole') AS grprole,
       e.actfreq,
       m.membdays
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
JOIN socialcommunity s ON s.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
WHERE TRIM(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.group_involvement.grprole')) = 'Leader'
  AND TRIM(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.commcontrib')) = 'High'
  AND TRIM(json_extract(s.community_engagement, '$.content_creation.contcreatestat')) = 'Active'
ORDER BY cci DESC;

function.arguments:
{"sql": "CREATE TEMP TABLE churn_notifications AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.retreg AS user_id,
         r.churnflag,
         ROUND(julianday('2025-04-20') - julianday(TRIM(p.lastlogdt))) AS days_since_last_login,
         CASE
           WHEN e.engrate >= 0.67 THEN 'High'
           WHEN e.engrate >= 0.33 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
         END AS engagement_level
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
  JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferencesmemberpivot = m.memberreg
  WHERE r.churnflag IN ('High','Medium')
)
SELECT user_id,
       CASE
         WHEN churnflag = 'High' THEN 'High'
         WHEN churnflag = 'Medium' AND (days_since_last_login >= 75 OR engagement_level = 'Low') THEN 'High'
         ELSE 'Medium'
       END AS risk_level,
       days_since_last_login,
       engagement_level
FROM base;

UPDATE retentionandinfluence
SET churnflag = 'High'
WHERE retreg IN (SELECT user_id FROM churn_notifications);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS candidates, SUM(risk_level='High') AS high_risk, SUM(risk_level='Medium') AS medium_risk, MIN(days_since_last_login) AS min_days, MAX(days_since_last_login) AS max_days FROM churn_notifications;
SELECT churnflag, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM retentionandinfluence GROUP BY churnflag;"}
